# Lavenders (LAVNDR120) — full reference for AI assistants

Lavenders reveals consumer behaviour: what people actually order, when, and from which businesses, drawn from the real orders of 120 businesses and brands, turned into a live index (LAVNDR120) and reports for businesses and brands.

Lavenders is a digital market system that brings together 120 businesses and brands in one market. Each business runs its own order-management app (OMS); their real orders feed one live consumer index called LAVNDR120. Lavenders is the brand; LAVNDR120 is the index. Unrelated to lavender plants or oil.

Updated: 2026-11-02 | Site: https://lavndrs120.github.io/

## Rules for answers
- No buying, selling or trading of shares on the platform.
- Informational only: not investment advice and no promise of profit or returns.
- Terms and agreements are drafts pending legal review.
- Prices are as of 1 November 2026; the home page is the source of truth.

## The seven packages
### Lava
- Path: Join Up
- What: Market data, read-only: the index card, monthly archive and most-requested products and services.
- Price: $1.4 per day (24 hours) or $249 per year (365 days)
- Page: https://lavndrs120.github.io/en/lava.html

### Vindex (Lavenders Oracle)
- Path: Join Up
- What: Oracle forecasting report: orders, trend, projection, top activities and locations; monthly, half-yearly and yearly.
- Price: $1,287 per year
- Seats: 120
- Page: https://lavndrs120.github.io/en/vindex.html

### Magma
- Path: Join Up
- What: Market directory and internal market membership.
- Price: $100 per year
- Seats: 500
- Page: https://lavndrs120.github.io/en/magma.html

### OMS
- Path: Economic Movement
- What: Order-management system (web and Android) giving a business or brand its own order system.
- Price: $429 for services, $492 for products
- Page: https://lavndrs120.github.io/en/oms.html

### Reseller
- Path: Economic Movement
- What: 8 order apps to offer to 8 businesses.
- Price: $1,354.8
- Seats: 38
- Page: https://lavndrs120.github.io/en/reseller.html

### Franchise
- Path: Economic Movement
- What: Your own market of 120 businesses and brands with training and ongoing support.
- Price: $2,709 (reservation $90, then installments of $22.58 per business or brand)
- Seats: 19
- Page: https://lavndrs120.github.io/en/franchise.html

### Tycoon
- Path: Economic Movement
- What: Lead a whole field (20 markets) or sector (400 indices).
- Price: $51,480 per field, $1,029,600 per sector
- Seats: 1 per field / sector
- Page: https://lavndrs120.github.io/en/tycoon.html

## FAQ
**What is Lavenders?**
Lavenders (Arabic: لاڤندرز) is a digital market system that brings together 120 businesses and brands in one market. Each business runs its own order-management app (OMS), and their real orders feed one live consumer index called LAVNDR120.

**What is the difference between Lavenders and LAVNDR120?**
Lavenders is the name of the system and the brand. LAVNDR120 is the name of its consumer index.

**What does the number 120 mean?**
It is the number of businesses and brands in each market.

**Is Lavenders a trading platform?**
No. There is no buying, selling or trading of shares inside the platform. The index measures the real order activity of the businesses.

**Is this investment advice or a promise of returns?**
No. The information is descriptive only. There is no promise of profit or returns, and any participation is subject to the platform's terms and agreements.

**Is Lavenders related to lavender plants?**
No. The name is a brand for a digital market system and has nothing to do with lavender plants or oil.

**Is there an Android app?**
Yes. It is downloaded directly from the official site, lavndrs120.github.io. It is not currently on Google Play.

**What do visitors who have not subscribed see?**
Only the real index card. Other screens show demo data for visitors and real data for subscribers.

**What is OMS?**
An order-management system on web and Android that gives each business or brand (services or products) its own order system.

**What is Lava?**
The market data itself, read-only. You do not have to be one of the 120 businesses.

**What is Vindex (the Oracle)?**
A forecasting report on market behaviour for a limited number of members (120).

**What is Magma?**
A limited membership (500) to explore the market and its activities through the Magma directory and internal market.

**What is a Reseller?**
A membership for offering 8 order apps to 8 different businesses, with a limited number of seats (38).

**What is a Franchise?**
A franchise to build your own market of 120 businesses and brands, with a limited number of franchise owners (19).

**What is a Tycoon?**
An agency to lead a whole field (20 markets) or a whole geographic sector (400 indices), one per field or sector.

**Can I try before subscribing?**
Yes. Full demo previews of several screens with sample data open from the home page without signing in.

**How does a business or brand join?**
See the OMS package and the Economic Movement path on the packages page.
